policy: 13 components share session-scoped anatomy condition; no runtime injury document/history writes; reconstruction/reopen resets injury.
limitations: Rigid proxy boxes approximate organs; tongue is internal and not externally projectile-hit-tested.
Vision uses one current player plus explicit visible signals; owned solid geometry occludes, noncolliding decoration does not.
External ears retain deeper hearing; no acoustic propagation or generated audio.
Scent is producer-supplied reception, not dispersion; taste uses explicit contact ID and proximity, with no automatic food interaction.
Automatic vegetation rustles and ecological recognition await future producers; no predator species or hunting AI added.
Benchmarks isolate real GLB mobs and bounded signal workloads in Chromium/SwiftShader, not overall-world hardware GPU/FPS.
Memory figures are serialized anatomy state and estimates, not measured retained JS heap.
